raw_segments.text: Why will you Jews not accept our culture, our religion, and our language?
You are a tribe of nomad herdsmen.
You have no cities nor no wealth.
Our cities are hives of humanity and our galleys, trireme and quadrierm, laden with all manner
merchandise for the waters of the known globe.
You have but emerged from primitive conditions.
We have a literature, a priesthood, an age-long history and a polity.
